changelog: Removed internal LLM calls from ask command. Traces are now returned as structured context for the agent to analyze — no third-party LLM calls, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY needed. Only outbound connection is to api.smith.langchain.com.
summary: Query and analyze LangSmith traces with natural language or structured commands. Use when the user asks about LangSmith runs, trace failures, latency, cost,...
